item.title: Leaders set ambitious goals to better the world by 2030. They've made little progress
item.description: In 2015, global leaders set ambitious goals to reduce inequality, end hunger and boost education. More than a decade later, the world is nowhere near achieving much of what was promised.

item.title: New book by Princess Diana's brother prompts war of words with King Charles III

item.description: United Nations head António Guterres returns to New York for his final U.N. General Assembly as diplomacy falters over wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, and the global body faces deep divisions.
